name: cross-fragment common and entity references

fragments.text: entity User {profile: Profile, team: Team}; entity Photo; action view appliesTo {principal: User, resource: Photo, context: {}};

schema: type Profile = {name: String, active: Bool}; entity Team; entity User {profile: Profile, team: Team}; entity Photo; action view appliesTo {principal: User, resource: Photo, context: {}};
policies: permit(principal, action, resource) when { principal.profile.active && principal.profile.name == "雪" && principal.team == Team::"a" };

name: qualified cross-namespace references and hierarchy

fragments.text: namespace App { entity User in Org::Team {profile: Shared::Profile}; entity Photo; action all; action view in all appliesTo {principal: User, resource: Photo, context: Shared::Context}; }
namespace Org { entity Group; entity Team in Group; } namespace Shared { type Profile = {name: String}; type Context = {mfa: Bool}; }

schema: namespace App { entity User in Org::Team {profile: Shared::Profile}; entity Photo; action all; action view in all appliesTo {principal: User, resource: Photo, context: Shared::Context}; } namespace Org { entity Group; entity Team in Group; } namespace Shared { type Profile = {name: String}; type Context = {mfa: Bool}; }
policies: permit(principal, action == App::Action::"view", resource) when { context.mfa };

name: extensions optional fields and enumerated entities

fragments.text: type Profile = {balance: decimal, source?: ipaddr}; entity User {profile: Profile}; entity Color enum ["red", "雪"]; action inspect appliesTo {principal: User, resource: Color, context: {stamp: datetime}};

schema: type Profile = {balance: decimal, source?: ipaddr}; entity User {profile: Profile}; entity Color enum ["red", "雪"]; action inspect appliesTo {principal: User, resource: Color, context: {stamp: datetime}};
policies: permit(principal, action, resource) when { principal.profile.balance > decimal("0") };
